page_title: CEL 1-0 SEV | Celta Vigo v Sevilla 23/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Neal Maupay (Sevilla) is the one who receives a yellow card.
90+5' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch for Javier Rueda.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
86' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) replacing Lucien Agoume.
83' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

82' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
77' Substitution. Oso will be replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
74' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Borja Iglesias and he is replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
74' Fernando Lopez just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Matias Vecino (Celta Vigo) replaces him.
73' The referee blows for a cooling break.
73' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' Great teamplay by Celta Vigo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
66' Here's the change. Iago Aspas leaves the pitch and Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) comes on as a substitute.
65' It will be a substitution. Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) is ready to enter the pitch as Williot Swedberg walks off.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Akor Adams (Sevilla) is coming onto the pitch as Isaac Romero cannot continue after picking up an injury.
64' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Neal Maupay (Sevilla) replaces Alexis Sanchez.
64' Substitution. Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) on for Peque.
63' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
60' A dangerous looking corner kick from Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) is cleared to safety by the defence.

58' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
56' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Sevilla is cautioned for aggressive play.

51' 1 - 0 Fernando Lopez slides a pass towards Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner. The score is now 1:0.
51' A player from Sevilla commits a rough challenge. Francisco Maeso blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Celta Vigo are awarded the free kick.

50' That was absolutely fantastic! Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
49' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Peque (Sevilla).
46' The attendance is 20901.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Dangerous play by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo). Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Isaac Romero (Sevilla) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
42' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
42' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
38' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
36' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Celta Vigo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francisco Maeso no option but to blow his whistle.
31' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

31' What a big chance! Peque (Sevilla) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
30' The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
27' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

24' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
24' Celta Vigo force a corner. They send men into the box.
20' Oso (Sevilla) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
17' Sevilla force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
15' Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
10' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
9' The attendance for today's match is 20901.
9' Francisco Maeso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) and blew his whistle.
7' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
6' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is able to continue to play.
4' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) picks up an injury.
